author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Five! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independently published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Do you like CRUNCH? Do you like Cowboy Bebop? Do you like Rogue Trader? Then Tanner, Eric and Gabe's WANTED! is probably for you. This casual non-competitive game of clearing contracts for credits and bringing in perps in a dusty dim-future is heavy on the options but light on the themes. 2x2 to 2x4 tables, 3 models aside, rules for multiplayer modes or solo. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules FOR FREE HERE :https://i.4pcdn.org/tg/1735079239665376.pdf
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 065 - WANTED! Reward CC 10,000 by  Tanner Simpson
